items.fr: Alors qu'est-ce que vous me conseillez ?
items.en: So what do you recommend?
items.respell: a-LOR kess kuh voo muh kohⁿ-seh-YAY
items.notes: The hand-back. Freeze and you lose the turn; hand the choice back and you keep it.

items.fr: Il manque un plat.
items.en: A dish is missing.
items.respell: eel MAHⁿK uhⁿ PLA
items.notes: A dish is missing. Shorter and easier than Ce n'est pas ce que j'ai commandé.

items.fr: Je suis désolé, il n'y en a plus.
items.en: I'm sorry, there's none left.
items.respell: zhuh süee day-zo-LAY eel nyahⁿ-n a PLÜ
items.notes: THE DEVIATION, and the line the whole of act 4 turns on. UNANALYSED LEXIS: il n'y en a plus contains both y and en, which belong to lesson 23 in A2 (which HAS shipped). It is never glossed, never decomposed, and never in a scored surface that turns on the pronouns. The learner recognises the chunk and reaches for a rung.

items.fr: Voilà pour vous.
items.en: Here you are.
items.respell: vwa-LA poor VOO
items.notes: Said on every delivery, at any stage, and it is the single most frequent thing a waiter says. Deliberately not tied to one stage.

items.fr: Excusez-moi pour l'attente.
items.en: Sorry for the wait.
items.respell: ehks-kü-zay MWA poor la-TAHⁿT
items.notes: An apology from the other side, which the corpus had none of. The learner has to recognise that nothing is being asked of them.

items.fr: Je crois qu'il y a une erreur sur l'addition.
items.en: I think there's a mistake on the bill.
items.ipa: /ʒə kʁwa kil j‿a yn e.ʁœʁ syʁ la.di.sjɔ̃/
items.respell: zhuh KRWA keel ya ün ay-REUR sür la-dee-SYOHⁿ
items.notes: A problem with the bill rather than with the food.

items.fr: Je vous en prie, prenez votre temps.
items.en: Please do, take your time.
items.respell: zhuh voo-zahⁿ pree pruh-nay votr TAHⁿ

items.fr: Ce serait gentil de me le confirmer.
items.en: It would be kind of you to confirm it for me.
items.ipa: /sə sə.ʁɛ ʒɑ̃.ti də mə lə kɔ̃.fiʁ.me/
items.respell: suh suh-reh zhahⁿ-tee duh muh luh kohⁿ-feer-MAY

items.fr: Merci beaucoup, vous me sauvez la journée.
items.en: Thank you very much, you are saving my day.
items.ipa: /mɛʁ.si bo.ku vu mə so.ve la ʒuʁ.ne/
items.respell: mer-see boh-koo voo muh soh-vay lah zhoor-NAY

items.fr: Je vous laisse mon numéro, au cas où.
items.en: I will leave you my number, just in case.
items.ipa: /ʒə vu lɛs mɔ̃ ny.me.ʁo o ka u/
items.respell: zhuh voo less mohⁿ nü-may-roh oh kah OO

items.fr: Je vous le remplace tout de suite.
items.en: I'll replace it for you right away.
items.ipa: /ʒə vu lə ʁɑ̃.plas tu d(ə) sɥit/
items.respell: zhuh voo luh rahⁿ-PLASS too duh SÜEET
items.notes: The repair from his side, and it carries the lesson 21 in A2 direct-object pronoun le in front of the verb. Exposure, not instruction: lesson 21 in A2 shipped at seq 21 and owns it.

items.fr: Je prendrais plutôt le poisson.
items.en: I'd rather have the fish.
items.respell: zhuh prahⁿ-DREH plü-TOH luh pwa-SOHⁿ
items.notes: The softest rung, and genuinely new lexis: the conditional of prendre in this use is at 0 restaurant rows. Carried as an unnamed fixed form. The conditional as a FAMILY is lesson 28 in A2's and is not named, conjugated or grouped here.

items.fr: Pour moi, ce sera l'entrecôte.
items.en: For me, it'll be the rib steak.
items.respell: poor MWA suh suh-RA lahⁿ-truh-KOHT
items.notes: The same frame with the person restored, which is how it is said at a table of four.

items.fr: On ferme la cuisine dans dix minutes.
items.en: The kitchen closes in ten minutes.
items.ipa: /ɔ̃ fɛʁm la kɥi.zin dɑ̃ di mi.nyt/
items.respell: ohⁿ fehrm la kü-ee-ZEEN dahⁿ dee mee-NÜT
items.notes: OFF SCRIPT. A statement that is really an instruction: order now or do not order. Nothing in it is a question and everything in it is urgent.

items.fr: Je reviens tout de suite.
items.en: I'll be right back.
items.respell: zhuh ruh-VYEHⁿ too duh SÜEET
items.notes: OFF SCRIPT. He is leaving mid-turn and will finish the exchange later. The learner who does not catch it thinks they have been forgotten.

items.fr: Ça sera sur votre gauche.
items.en: It will be on your left.
items.respell: sa suh-RA sür VOH-truh GOHSH
items.notes: Sur votre gauche, not à gauche: the side of you rather than the direction to turn. The two are one word apart and mean different things.

items.fr: Continuez tout droit, puis tournez à gauche.
items.en: Keep going straight, then turn left.
items.ipa: /kɔ̃.ti.nɥe tu dʁwa pɥi tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ/
items.respell: kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY too DRWAH pwee toor-NAY ah GOHSH
items.notes: GO then TURN, joined by puis. The cleanest two-move shape there is.

items.fr: Prenez la première à droite, puis traversez la place.
items.en: Take the first on the right, then cross the square.
items.ipa: /pʁə.ne la pʁə.mjɛʁ a dʁwat pɥi tʁa.vɛʁ.se la plas/
items.respell: pruh-NAY lah pruh-MYEHR ah DRWAHT pwee trah-vehr-SAY lah PLAHSS
items.notes: TURN then PASS, with an ordinal inside the first move.

items.fr: Tournez à gauche au feu, ensuite continuez tout droit.
items.en: Turn left at the lights, then keep going straight.
items.ipa: /tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ o fø ɑ̃.sɥit kɔ̃.ti.nɥe tu dʁwa/
items.respell: toor-NAY ah GOHSH oh FEU ahⁿ-SWEET kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY too DRWAH
items.notes: Ensuite instead of puis. They are interchangeable here and a learner who only knows one loses half the joints.

items.fr: Allez jusqu'au carrefour, puis prenez à droite.
items.en: Go to the crossroads, then turn right.
items.ipa: /a.le ʒys.ko kaʁ.fuʁ pɥi pʁə.ne a dʁwat/
items.respell: ah-LAY zhüs-koh kar-FOOR pwee pruh-NAY ah DRWAHT
items.notes: Jusqu'au inside move one, puis between the two. Two joints, one chain, and only one of them separates moves.

items.fr: Je vais demander en cuisine.
items.en: I'll go and ask in the kitchen.
items.respell: zhuh veh duh-mahⁿ-DAY ahⁿ kü-ee-ZEEN
items.notes: It closes the exchange without answering it, which is what actually happens.

items.fr: Traversez le pont, ensuite tournez à gauche.
items.en: Cross the bridge, then turn left.
items.ipa: /tʁa.vɛʁ.se lə pɔ̃ ɑ̃.sɥit tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ/
items.respell: trah-vehr-SAY luh POHⁿ ahⁿ-SWEET toor-NAY ah GOHSH
items.notes: PASS then TURN. The order matters: crossing first and turning first put you on opposite banks.

items.fr: Remontez la rue, puis prenez la deuxième à droite.
items.en: Go back up the street, then take the second on the right.
items.ipa: /ʁə.mɔ̃.te la ʁy pɥi pʁə.ne la dø.zjɛm a dʁwat/
items.respell: ruh-mohⁿ-TAY lah RÜ pwee pruh-NAY lah deu-ZYEM ah DRWAHT
items.notes: The ordinal sits at the end, unstressed, between two content words. That is where it goes missing.

items.fr: Longez le parc, ensuite traversez la rue.
items.en: Follow the park along, then cross the street.
items.ipa: /lɔ̃.ʒe lə paʁk ɑ̃.sɥit tʁa.vɛʁ.se la ʁy/
items.respell: lohⁿ-ZHAY luh PARK ahⁿ-SWEET trah-vehr-SAY lah RÜ
items.notes: Two PASS moves in a row. Nothing changes heading, which is what makes them easy to collapse into one.

items.fr: Passez devant la poste, puis c'est sur votre droite.
items.en: Go past the post office, then it is on your right.
items.ipa: /pa.se də.vɑ̃ la pɔst pɥi sɛ syʁ vɔtʁ dʁwat/
items.respell: pah-SAY duh-VAHⁿ lah POST pwee seh sür VOH-truh DRWAHT
items.notes: PASS then ARRIVE. Puis in front of an ARRIVE move is the signal the instruction has finished.

items.fr: Continuez jusqu'au rond-point, ensuite prenez la sortie à droite.
items.en: Carry on to the roundabout, then take the right exit.
items.ipa: /kɔ̃.ti.nɥe ʒys.ko ʁɔ̃.pwɛ̃ ɑ̃.sɥit pʁə.ne la sɔʁ.ti a dʁwat/
items.respell: kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY zhüs-koh rohⁿ-PWEHⁿ ahⁿ-SWEET pruh-NAY lah sor-TEE ah DRWAHT
items.notes: Le rond-point is published as a headword in four themes and used in an instruction in none of them.

items.fr: Prenez le boulevard, puis vous verrez la gare.
items.en: Take the boulevard, then you will see the station.
items.ipa: /pʁə.ne lə bul.vaʁ pɥi vu vɛ.ʁe la ɡaʁ/
items.respell: pruh-NAY luh bool-VAR pwee voo veh-RAY lah GAHR
items.notes: GO then ARRIVE, with no TURN at all. A two-move chain does not have to change heading.

items.fr: Tournez à droite après la banque, puis continuez tout droit.
items.en: Turn right after the bank, then keep going straight.
items.ipa: /tuʁ.ne a dʁwat a.pʁɛ la bɑ̃k pɥi kɔ̃.ti.nɥe tu dʁwa/
items.respell: toor-NAY ah DRWAHT ah-PREH lah BAHⁿK pwee kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY too DRWAH
items.notes: Après inside move one and puis between the moves. Two joints of different jobs in one short chain.

items.fr: Allez au bout de la rue, puis tournez à gauche.
items.en: Go to the end of the street, then turn left.
items.ipa: /a.le o bu də la ʁy pɥi tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ/
items.respell: ah-LAY oh BOO duh lah RÜ pwee toor-NAY ah GOHSH
items.notes: Au bout de is a joint of four words. Heard fast it is one syllable and a learner hears only bout.

items.fr: Traversez la place, ensuite c'est juste en face.
items.en: Cross the square, then it is just opposite.
items.ipa: /tʁa.vɛʁ.se la plas ɑ̃.sɥit sɛ ʒyst ɑ̃ fas/
items.respell: trah-vehr-SAY lah PLAHSS ahⁿ-SWEET seh zhüst ahⁿ FAHSS
items.notes: En face is the preposition en, not the pronoun. Lesson 23 in A2 owns the pronoun and this unit does not touch it.

items.fr: Prenez la deuxième à gauche, puis longez le canal.
items.en: Take the second on the left, then follow the canal.
items.ipa: /pʁə.ne la dø.zjɛm a ɡoʃ pɥi lɔ̃.ʒe lə ka.nal/
items.respell: pruh-NAY lah deu-ZYEM ah GOHSH pwee lohⁿ-ZHAY luh ka-NAL
items.notes: The ordinal and the verb with no English equivalent, in one chain. Both are droppable and dropping either loses the route.

items.fr: Continuez tout droit, tournez à gauche, c'est en face.
items.en: Keep straight, turn left, it is opposite.
items.ipa: /kɔ̃.ti.nɥe tu dʁwa tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ sɛ.tɑ̃ fas/
items.respell: kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY too DRWAH toor-NAY ah GOHSH seh-tahⁿ FAHSS
items.notes: GO, TURN, ARRIVE with commas doing the joints' work. A comma is a joint you cannot hear, which is the hardest case.

items.fr: Prenez la première à droite, traversez la place, puis continuez.
items.en: Take the first right, cross the square, then carry on.
items.ipa: /pʁə.ne la pʁə.mjɛʁ a dʁwat tʁa.vɛʁ.se la plas pɥi kɔ̃.ti.nɥe/
items.respell: pruh-NAY lah pruh-MYEHR ah DRWAHT trah-vehr-SAY lah PLAHSS pwee kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY
items.notes: One spoken joint and one comma. The learner who counts only puis counts two moves and walks two thirds of the route.

items.fr: Allez jusqu'au feu, tournez à droite, c'est après la pharmacie.
items.en: Go to the lights, turn right, it is after the chemist.
items.ipa: /a.le ʒys.ko fø tuʁ.ne a dʁwat sɛ.ta.pʁɛ la faʁ.ma.si/
items.respell: ah-LAY zhüs-koh FEU toor-NAY ah DRWAHT seh-tah-PREH lah far-mah-SEE
items.notes: Après appears here as part of an ARRIVE move rather than as a joint. The same word does both jobs.

items.fr: Traversez le pont, puis longez le quai jusqu'à la place.
items.en: Cross the bridge, then follow the quay to the square.
items.ipa: /tʁa.vɛʁ.se lə pɔ̃ pɥi lɔ̃.ʒe lə kɛ ʒys.ka la plas/
items.respell: trah-vehr-SAY luh POHⁿ pwee lohⁿ-ZHAY luh KEH zhüs-KA lah PLAHSS
items.notes: Le quai is a station platform at a1 and a riverside here. Same word, and the context is the only thing that separates them.

items.fr: Remontez la rue, prenez la deuxième à gauche, c'est au coin.
items.en: Go up the street, take the second left, it is on the corner.
items.ipa: /ʁə.mɔ̃.te la ʁy pʁə.ne la dø.zjɛm a ɡoʃ sɛ.to kwɛ̃/
items.respell: ruh-mohⁿ-TAY lah RÜ pruh-NAY lah deu-ZYEM ah GOHSH seh-toh KWEHⁿ
items.notes: Three moves, no spoken joint at all. Only the commas separate them and a comma has no sound.

items.fr: Sortez de la gare, tournez à droite, puis continuez tout droit.
items.en: Leave the station, turn right, then keep going straight.
items.ipa: /sɔʁ.te də la ɡaʁ tuʁ.ne a dʁwat pɥi kɔ̃.ti.nɥe tu dʁwa/
items.respell: sor-TAY duh lah GAHR toor-NAY ah DRWAHT pwee kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY too DRWAH
items.notes: The move a learner standing at a station actually needs first, and it is published nowhere.

items.fr: Passez devant la mairie, traversez la place, c'est sur votre gauche.
items.en: Go past the town hall, cross the square, it is on your left.
items.ipa: /pa.se də.vɑ̃ la mɛ.ʁi tʁa.vɛʁ.se la plas sɛ syʁ vɔtʁ ɡoʃ/
items.respell: pah-SAY duh-VAHⁿ lah meh-REE trah-vehr-SAY lah PLAHSS seh sür VOH-truh GOHSH
items.notes: Two PASS moves then ARRIVE. Nothing turns, so a learner listening for a turn hears no instruction at all.

items.fr: Prenez le pont, ensuite la première à droite, puis tout droit.
items.en: Take the bridge, then the first right, then straight on.
items.ipa: /pʁə.ne lə pɔ̃ ɑ̃.sɥit la pʁə.mjɛʁ a dʁwat pɥi tu dʁwa/
items.respell: pruh-NAY luh POHⁿ ahⁿ-SWEET lah pruh-MYEHR ah DRWAHT pwee too DRWAH
items.notes: Moves two and three have no verb in them at all. The joint is carrying the whole move, which is the strongest argument for counting joints.

items.fr: Continuez jusqu'au rond-point, prenez la troisième sortie, c'est en face.
items.en: Carry on to the roundabout, take the third exit, it is opposite.
items.ipa: /kɔ̃.ti.nɥe ʒys.ko ʁɔ̃.pwɛ̃ pʁə.ne la tʁwa.zjɛm sɔʁ.ti sɛ.tɑ̃ fas/
items.respell: kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY zhüs-koh rohⁿ-PWEHⁿ pruh-NAY lah trwah-ZYEM sor-TEE seh-tahⁿ FAHSS
items.notes: The one place an ordinal counts exits rather than streets, and getting it wrong at a roundabout is a whole different road.

items.fr: Longez le parc, tournez à gauche au feu, puis vous verrez.
items.en: Follow the park, turn left at the lights, then you will see it.
items.ipa: /lɔ̃.ʒe lə paʁk tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ o fø pɥi vu vɛ.ʁe/
items.respell: lohⁿ-ZHAY luh PARK toor-NAY ah GOHSH oh FEU pwee voo veh-RAY
items.notes: Vous verrez as a whole ARRIVE move with no place named. It means you cannot miss it, and it names nothing you can check.

items.fr: Allez tout droit, traversez la rue, c'est juste après la banque.
items.en: Go straight, cross the street, it is just after the bank.
items.ipa: /a.le tu dʁwa tʁa.vɛʁ.se la ʁy sɛ ʒyst a.pʁɛ la bɑ̃k/
items.respell: ah-LAY too DRWAH trah-vehr-SAY lah RÜ seh zhüst ah-PREH lah BAHⁿK
items.notes: Allez rather than continuez for the same GO move. Four verbs mean go and the choice between them carries nothing.

items.fr: Tournez à gauche, continuez jusqu'au bout, c'est le bâtiment gris.
items.en: Turn left, carry on to the end, it is the grey building.
items.ipa: /tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ kɔ̃.ti.nɥe ʒys.ko bu sɛ lə ba.ti.mɑ̃ ɡʁi/
items.respell: toor-NAY ah GOHSH kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY zhüs-koh BOO seh luh bah-tee-MAHⁿ GREE
items.notes: Jusqu'au bout with no noun after it. The joint has swallowed the landmark, which is normal and unteachable from a word list.

items.fr: Prenez la rue à droite, passez devant l'école, puis tournez à gauche.
items.en: Take the street on the right, pass the school, then turn left.
items.ipa: /pʁə.ne la ʁy a dʁwat pa.se də.vɑ̃ le.kɔl pɥi tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ/
items.respell: pruh-NAY lah RÜ ah DRWAHT pah-SAY duh-VAHⁿ lay-KOL pwee toor-NAY ah GOHSH
items.notes: TURN, PASS, TURN. Two changes of heading with a landmark between them, and the landmark is not where you stop.

items.fr: Continuez tout droit, tournez à gauche, traversez la place, c'est en face.
items.en: Straight on, turn left, cross the square, it is opposite.
items.ipa: /kɔ̃.ti.nɥe tu dʁwa tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ tʁa.vɛʁ.se la plas sɛ.tɑ̃ fas/
items.respell: kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY too DRWAH toor-NAY ah GOHSH trah-vehr-SAY lah PLAHSS seh-tahⁿ FAHSS
items.notes: One of each move type, in order, with no spoken joint. Twelve words and four things to hold.

items.fr: Prenez la deuxième à droite, longez le parc, traversez la rue, c'est là.
items.en: Second right, follow the park, cross the street, it is there.
items.ipa: /pʁə.ne la dø.zjɛm a dʁwat lɔ̃.ʒe lə paʁk tʁa.vɛʁ.se la ʁy sɛ la/
items.respell: pruh-NAY lah deu-ZYEM ah DRWAHT lohⁿ-ZHAY luh PARK trah-vehr-SAY lah RÜ seh LAH
items.notes: C'est là as the whole ARRIVE move. It names nothing, and a learner who was still translating move one hears it as filler.

items.fr: Allez jusqu'au feu, tournez à droite, passez le pont, c'est après.
items.en: Go to the lights, turn right, cross the bridge, it is after.
items.ipa: /a.le ʒys.ko fø tuʁ.ne a dʁwat pa.se lə pɔ̃ sɛ.ta.pʁɛ/
items.respell: ah-LAY zhüs-koh FEU toor-NAY ah DRWAHT pah-SAY luh POHⁿ seh-tah-PREH
items.notes: C'est après with nothing after it. The landmark is the bridge you just crossed and the sentence does not say so.

items.fr: Sortez de la gare, tout droit, deuxième à gauche, c'est au coin.
items.en: Out of the station, straight on, second left, on the corner.
items.ipa: /sɔʁ.te də la ɡaʁ tu dʁwa dø.zjɛm a ɡoʃ sɛ.to kwɛ̃/
items.respell: sor-TAY duh lah GAHR too DRWAH deu-ZYEM ah GOHSH seh-toh KWEHⁿ
items.notes: Moves two, three and four have no verb. This is what a hurried passer-by actually says and no word list prepares a learner for it.

items.fr: Traversez la place, remontez la rue, prenez la première à droite, continuez.
items.en: Cross the square, up the street, first right, carry on.
items.ipa: /tʁa.vɛʁ.se la plas ʁə.mɔ̃.te la ʁy pʁə.ne la pʁə.mjɛʁ a dʁwat kɔ̃.ti.nɥe/
items.respell: trah-vehr-SAY lah PLAHSS ruh-mohⁿ-TAY lah RÜ pruh-NAY lah pruh-MYEHR ah DRWAHT kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY
items.notes: Ends on a GO with no destination. The instruction stops before the route does, which is the commonest real shape.

items.fr: Tournez à gauche, allez jusqu'au pont, traversez, c'est sur votre droite.
items.en: Turn left, go to the bridge, cross, it is on your right.
items.ipa: /tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ a.le ʒys.ko pɔ̃ tʁa.vɛʁ.se sɛ syʁ vɔtʁ dʁwat/
items.respell: toor-NAY ah GOHSH ah-LAY zhüs-koh POHⁿ trah-vehr-SAY seh sür VOH-truh DRWAHT
items.notes: Traversez alone, with no object. The bridge from the move before is what you cross and nothing in the words says it.

items.fr: Prenez le boulevard, puis la troisième à gauche, traversez, c'est en face.
items.en: Take the boulevard, then third left, cross, it is opposite.
items.ipa: /pʁə.ne lə bul.vaʁ pɥi la tʁwa.zjɛm a ɡoʃ tʁa.vɛʁ.se sɛ.tɑ̃ fas/
items.respell: pruh-NAY luh bool-VAR pwee lah trwah-ZYEM ah GOHSH trah-vehr-SAY seh-tahⁿ FAHSS
items.notes: One spoken joint out of three. Counting puis gives you two moves and there are four.

items.fr: Continuez jusqu'au rond-point, deuxième sortie, longez le canal, c'est là.
items.en: On to the roundabout, second exit, follow the canal, it is there.
items.ipa: /kɔ̃.ti.nɥe ʒys.ko ʁɔ̃.pwɛ̃ dø.zjɛm sɔʁ.ti lɔ̃.ʒe lə ka.nal sɛ la/
items.respell: kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY zhüs-koh rohⁿ-PWEHⁿ deu-ZYEM sor-TEE lohⁿ-ZHAY luh ka-NAL seh LAH
items.notes: Deuxième sortie with no verb and no article on sortie. Four moves in eleven words.

items.fr: Descendez ici, traversez la rue, prenez la première à droite, continuez.
items.en: Get off here, cross the street, first right, carry on.
items.ipa: /de.sɑ̃.de i.si tʁa.vɛʁ.se la ʁy pʁə.ne la pʁə.mjɛʁ a dʁwat kɔ̃.ti.nɥe/
items.respell: day-sahⁿ-DAY ee-SEE trah-vehr-SAY lah RÜ pruh-NAY lah pruh-MYEHR ah DRWAHT kohⁿ-tee-nü-AY
items.notes: Said by a driver or another passenger rather than by somebody in the street. Same shape, different speaker.

items.fr: Passez devant l'église, tournez à gauche, allez tout droit, c'est là.
items.en: Past the church, turn left, go straight, it is there.
items.ipa: /pa.se də.vɑ̃ le.ɡliz tuʁ.ne a ɡoʃ a.le tu dʁwa sɛ la/
items.respell: pah-SAY duh-VAHⁿ lay-GLEEZ toor-NAY ah GOHSH ah-LAY too DRWAH seh LAH
items.notes: PASS, TURN, GO, ARRIVE. The landmark comes first here, which is where a learner expects the endpoint.

items.fr: Remontez la rue, traversez le carrefour, première à droite, c'est après.
items.en: Up the street, across the crossroads, first right, it is after.
items.ipa: /ʁə.mɔ̃.te la ʁy tʁa.vɛʁ.se lə kaʁ.fuʁ pʁə.mjɛʁ a dʁwat sɛ.ta.pʁɛ/
items.respell: ruh-mohⁿ-TAY lah RÜ trah-vehr-SAY luh kar-FOOR pruh-MYEHR ah DRWAHT seh-tah-PREH
items.notes: Première with no article at all. Under speed the ordinal is one unstressed syllable between two content words.

items.fr: Allez tout droit, deuxième à gauche, passez la banque, c'est en face.
items.en: Straight on, second left, past the bank, it is opposite.
items.ipa: /a.le tu dʁwa dø.zjɛm a ɡoʃ pa.se la bɑ̃k sɛ.tɑ̃ fas/
items.respell: ah-LAY too DRWAH deu-ZYEM ah GOHSH pah-SAY lah BAHⁿK seh-tahⁿ FAHSS
items.notes: Twelve words, four moves, no joint you can hear. This is the rung-4 shape the trap drill gates on.

items.fr: la deuxième à droite
items.en: the second on the right
items.respell: lah deu-ZYEM ah DRWAHT
items.notes: Two unstressed syllables between la and à. The half of the pair that goes missing.

items.fr: la troisième à droite
items.en: the third on the right
items.respell: lah trwah-ZYEM ah DRWAHT
items.notes: Troisième is longer and survives speed better than deuxième, which is why the confusion runs one way.

items.fr: la deuxième à gauche
items.en: the second on the left
items.respell: lah deu-ZYEM ah GOHSH
items.notes: The same ordinal with the other side. Getting the ordinal right and the side wrong is a different street.

items.fr: la première rue à gauche
items.en: the first street on the left
items.respell: lah pruh-MYEHR RÜ ah GOHSH
items.notes: With rue put back in. The full form is easier and is not what is said in a hurry.

items.fr: Ce n'est pas la première, c'est la deuxième.
items.en: It is not the first, it is the second.
items.ipa: /sə nɛ pa la pʁə.mjɛʁ sɛ la dø.zjɛm/
items.respell: suh neh pah lah pruh-MYEHR seh lah deu-ZYEM
items.notes: A correction, which is what a passer-by says when they see you set off wrong. Negation is lesson 21 in A1's and is used here, not taught.

items.fr: Prenez la troisième, pas la deuxième.
items.en: Take the third, not the second.
items.respell: pruh-NAY lah trwah-ZYEM pah lah deu-ZYEM
items.notes: Both ordinals in one line so the contrast is audible rather than described.

items.fr: C'est la deuxième rue, après le feu.
items.en: It is the second street, after the lights.
items.ipa: /sɛ la dø.zjɛm ʁy a.pʁɛ lə fø/
items.respell: seh lah deu-ZYEM RÜ ah-PREH luh FEU
items.notes: The ordinal is counted from the lights, not from where you stand. Nothing in the sentence says so.

items.fr: Comptez deux rues, puis tournez à droite.
items.en: Count two streets, then turn right.
items.ipa: /kɔ̃.te dø ʁy pɥi tuʁ.ne a dʁwat/
items.respell: kohⁿ-TAY deu RÜ pwee toor-NAY ah DRWAHT
items.notes: A cardinal doing an ordinal's job. Deux rues then turn is the third street, not the second, and that off-by-one is real.

items.fr: Le train à destination de Lyon partira voie douze.
items.en: The train for Lyon will depart from platform twelve.
items.ipa: /lə tʁɛ̃ a dɛs.ti.na.sjɔ̃ də ljɔ̃ paʁ.ti.ʁa vwa duz/
items.respell: luh TREHⁿ ah des-tee-nah-SYOHⁿ duh lee-OHⁿ par-tee-RA vwah DOOZ
items.notes: The canonical shape: destination fronted, then the platform as a bare number. Zero rows in the corpus had it.

items.fr: Le train en provenance de Marseille entre en gare.
items.en: The train from Marseille is arriving.
items.ipa: /lə tʁɛ̃ ɑ̃ pʁɔv.nɑ̃s də maʁ.sɛj ɑ̃tʁ ɑ̃ ɡaʁ/
items.respell: luh TREHⁿ ahⁿ prov-NAHⁿSS duh mar-SEY ahⁿtr ahⁿ GAHR
items.notes: En provenance de is arriving and à destination de is leaving. Four syllables apart and opposite platforms.

items.fr: Attention au départ, voie quatorze.
items.en: Stand clear, departure from platform fourteen.
items.respell: ah-tahⁿ-SYOHⁿ oh day-PAR vwah ka-TORZ
items.notes: The doors-closing warning. Attention here is a warning, not the noun a1 taught.

items.fr: Le train aura un retard d'environ vingt minutes.
items.en: The train will be about twenty minutes late.
items.ipa: /lə tʁɛ̃ o.ʁa œ̃ ʁə.taʁ dɑ̃.vi.ʁɔ̃ vɛ̃ mi.nyt/
items.respell: luh TREHⁿ oh-RA uhⁿ ruh-TAR dahⁿ-vee-ROHⁿ vehⁿ mee-NÜT
items.notes: A nominalised delay: aura un retard rather than sera en retard. The noun is what makes it sound official.

items.fr: Éloignez-vous de la bordure du quai, s'il vous plaît.
items.en: Please stand back from the platform edge.
items.ipa: /e.lwa.ɲe vu də la bɔʁ.dyʁ dy kɛ sil vu plɛ/
items.respell: ay-lwah-NYAY VOO duh lah bor-DÜR dü KEH seel voo PLEH
items.notes: A safety instruction using the same whole-form shape as a direction. It is an instruction to obey, not a route.

items.fr: Le train à destination de Bordeaux part dans cinq minutes.
items.en: The train for Bordeaux leaves in five minutes.
items.ipa: /lə tʁɛ̃ a dɛs.ti.na.sjɔ̃ də bɔʁ.do paʁ dɑ̃ sɛ̃k mi.nyt/
items.respell: luh TREHⁿ ah des-tee-nah-SYOHⁿ duh bor-DOH par dahⁿ sehⁿk mee-NÜT
items.notes: The same frame with a time instead of a platform. The frame is fixed and what follows it is not.

items.fr: Prochain arrêt, Châtelet. Correspondance ligne quatre.
items.en: Next stop, Châtelet. Change here for line four.
items.respell: pro-SHEHⁿ ah-REH shat-LEH ko-res-pohⁿ-DAHⁿSS leeny KATR
items.notes: The metro version: two fragments, no verb in either. A line number is read as a bare cardinal.

items.fr: Ce train ne dessert pas la gare de Massy.
items.en: This train does not stop at Massy station.
items.ipa: /sə tʁɛ̃ nə de.sɛʁ pa la ɡaʁ də ma.si/
items.respell: suh TREHⁿ nuh day-SEHR pah lah GAHR duh mah-SEE
items.notes: Desservir is the announcement word for stopping at. A negative announcement is the one that costs you a journey.

items.fr: Le train pour Rennes est annoncé avec dix minutes de retard.
items.en: The train to Rennes is announced ten minutes late.
items.ipa: /lə tʁɛ̃ puʁ ʁɛn ɛ.ta.nɔ̃.se a.vɛk di mi.nyt də ʁə.taʁ/
items.respell: luh TREHⁿ poor REN eh-tah-nohⁿ-SAY ah-vek dee mee-NÜT duh ruh-TAR
items.notes: Est annoncé avec is the station's formula for a delay and means nothing outside a station.

items.fr: Terminus, tout le monde descend.
items.en: End of the line, everybody off.
items.respell: ter-mee-NÜSS too luh MOHⁿD day-SAHⁿ
items.notes: Five words that end a journey. Descend here is the same verb the direction chains use for getting off.

items.fr: En raison d'un incident, le trafic est interrompu.
items.en: Because of an incident, service is suspended.
items.ipa: /ɑ̃ ʁɛ.zɔ̃ dœ̃ ɛ̃.si.dɑ̃ lə tʁa.fik ɛ.tɛ̃.te.ʁɔ̃.py/
items.respell: ahⁿ reh-ZOHⁿ duhⁿ ehⁿ-see-DAHⁿ luh trah-FEEK eh-tehⁿ-tay-rohⁿ-PÜ
items.notes: The formula that means your line has stopped. En raison de is the announcement register for parce que.

items.fr: Le prochain métro passera dans quatre minutes.
items.en: The next metro will come in four minutes.
items.ipa: /lə pʁɔ.ʃɛ̃ me.tʁo pa.sə.ʁa dɑ̃ katʁ mi.nyt/
items.respell: luh pro-SHEHⁿ may-TROH pah-suh-RA dahⁿ katr mee-NÜT
items.notes: Passera rather than arrivera. The train passes through; it does not arrive for you.

items.fr: Attention à la marche en descendant du train.
items.en: Mind the step when getting off the train.
items.ipa: /a.tɑ̃.sjɔ̃ a la maʁʃ ɑ̃ de.sɑ̃.dɑ̃ dy tʁɛ̃/
items.respell: ah-tahⁿ-SYOHⁿ ah lah MARSH ahⁿ day-sahⁿ-DAHⁿ dü TREHⁿ
items.notes: The French of mind the gap. La marche is the step, not walking, and the two are the same word.

items.fr: Les portes vont se fermer, éloignez-vous.
items.en: The doors are closing, stand back.
items.ipa: /le pɔʁt vɔ̃ sə fɛʁ.me e.lwa.ɲe vu/
items.respell: lay PORT vohⁿ suh fer-MAY ay-lwah-NYAY VOO
items.notes: Two moves in six words, both instructions. The futur proche is lesson 1 in A2's and is used, not taught.

items.fr: Le train à destination de Lille partira du quai numéro huit.
items.en: The train for Lille will leave from platform eight.
items.ipa: /lə tʁɛ̃ a dɛs.ti.na.sjɔ̃ də lil paʁ.ti.ʁa dy kɛ ny.me.ʁo ɥit/
items.respell: luh TREHⁿ ah des-tee-nah-SYOHⁿ duh LEEL par-tee-RA dü KEH nü-may-ROH ÜEET
items.notes: Quai numéro rather than voie. Both mean platform and a station uses whichever it uses.

items.fr: Aller simple ou aller-retour ?
items.en: One way or return?
items.respell: ah-LAY SEHⁿPL oo ah-lay-ruh-TOOR
items.notes: Both halves are published as a1 headwords and neither has ever been asked as a question.

items.fr: Vous voyagez seul ?
items.en: Are you travelling alone?
items.respell: voo vwah-yah-ZHAY SEUL
items.notes: Asked to price the ticket. It sounds personal and it is administrative.

items.fr: Il y a un train à quatorze heures dix.
items.en: There is a train at ten past two.
items.ipa: /i.lja œ̃ tʁɛ̃ a ka.tɔʁz œʁ dis/
items.respell: ee-lyah uhⁿ TREHⁿ ah ka-TORZ eur DEESS
items.notes: The twenty-four hour clock is lesson 15 in A1's and arrives here inside somebody else's turn, at speed.

items.fr: C'est complet, il reste des places à seize heures.
items.en: That one is full, there are seats at four.
items.ipa: /sɛ kɔ̃.plɛ il ʁɛst de plas a sɛz œʁ/
items.respell: seh kohⁿ-PLEH eel rest day PLAHSS ah sez EUR
items.notes: The refusal and the alternative in one breath. A learner listening for oui or non hears neither.

items.fr: Pardon, madame. Je cherche la gare, s'il vous plaît.
items.en: Excuse me. I am looking for the station, please.
items.ipa: /paʁ.dɔ̃ ma.dam ʒə ʃɛʁʃ la ɡaʁ sil vu plɛ/
items.respell: par-DOHⁿ mah-DAM zhuh SHERSH lah GAHR seel voo PLEH
items.notes: THE STREET OPENING: apology first, then the goal. Said at a counter it reads as lost rather than transacting.

items.fr: Un aller simple pour Nantes, s'il vous plaît.
items.en: A single to Nantes, please.
items.ipa: /œ̃.na.le sɛ̃pl puʁ nɑ̃t sil vu plɛ/
items.respell: uhⁿ-nah-LAY SEHⁿPL poor NAHⁿT seel voo PLEH
items.notes: Elliptical, with no verb. The counter form is shorter than the street form and that is the whole contrast.

items.fr: Je voudrais un billet pour demain matin.
items.en: I would like a ticket for tomorrow morning.
items.ipa: /ʒə vu.dʁɛ œ̃ bi.jɛ puʁ də.mɛ̃ ma.tɛ̃/
items.respell: zhuh voo-DREH uhⁿ bee-YEH poor duh-MEHⁿ ma-TEHⁿ
items.notes: Je voudrais, stored whole, as a softer je veux. Lesson 7 in A2 shipped the form; the family that explains it comes later and not here.

items.fr: Le prochain train est à quelle heure ?
items.en: What time is the next train?
items.respell: luh pro-SHEHⁿ TREHⁿ eh-tah keh-LEUR
items.notes: Rising intonation on a full sentence. TCF EO caps a candidate who produces only one question form, which is why the scenario carries three.

items.fr: Pardon, je cherche l'arrêt du bus quarante-deux.
items.en: Sorry, I am looking for the number forty-two bus stop.
items.ipa: /paʁ.dɔ̃ ʒə ʃɛʁʃ la.ʁɛ dy bys ka.ʁɑ̃t dø/
items.respell: par-DOHⁿ zhuh SHERSH lah-REH dü büss ka-rahⁿt-DEU
items.notes: The street opening with a bus number in it. A number inside your own question is the one you will have to repeat.

items.fr: C'est la deuxième ou la troisième ?
items.en: Is it the second or the third?
items.respell: seh lah deu-ZYEM oo lah trwah-ZYEM
items.notes: The unit's signature line. It names the one thing you missed and gets back four words instead of fourteen.

items.fr: À gauche ou à droite, pardon ?
items.en: Left or right, sorry?
items.respell: ah GOHSH oo ah DRWAHT par-DOHⁿ
items.notes: Pardon on the end rather than the front. It is lesson 24 in A2's rung 1 used as a tag, which costs less than using it alone.

items.fr: Je jette le ticket.
items.en: I throw the ticket away.
items.respell: zhuh ZHET luh tee-KEH
items.notes: jeter doubles and acheter does not, and both end in -eter. This is the pair that has to be learnt.

items.fr: Nous jetons tout.
items.en: We throw everything away.
items.respell: noo zhuh-TOHⁿ TOO
items.notes: One t. Whatever a verb does in the silent cells, nous and vous get the plain stem back.

items.fr: Je protège mes photos.
items.en: I protect my photos.
items.respell: zhuh proh-TEZH may fo-TO
items.notes: The ending went silent, so the é opens to è. That is the second mechanism.

items.fr: Nous protégeons nos photos.
items.en: We protect our photos.
items.respell: noo proh-tay-ZHOHⁿ no fo-TO
items.notes: The same verb, the other mechanism: a g in front of an o, so the e goes in and the é stays closed.

items.fr: Tu commences le cours lundi.
items.en: You start the class on Monday.
items.respell: tü koh-MAHⁿS luh koor luhⁿ-DEE
items.notes: tu takes a silent -es and the c is left alone. Only nous touches it.

items.fr: Ils lancent le projet lundi.
items.en: They launch the project on Monday.
items.respell: eel lahⁿs luh pro-ZHEH luhⁿ-DEE
items.notes: The -ent is silent and the c is soft in front of it, so lancer looks like any other verb here.

items.fr: On commence à sept heures.
items.en: We start at seven.
items.respell: ohⁿ koh-MAHⁿS a seh-TEUR
items.notes: on takes the il form, so the cedilla never arrives. Said out loud, this change is one you rarely need.

items.fr: Ils comprennent la question.
items.en: They understand the question.
items.respell: eel kohⁿ-PREN la kes-TYOHⁿ
items.notes: Two n again. Three verbs on this screen and the doubling arrives in the same cell every time.

items.fr: Le film surprend Marie.
items.en: The film surprises Marie.
items.respell: luh FEELM sür-PRAHⁿ ma-REE
items.notes: The third one in the family, and the ending is prend with nothing changed.

items.fr: J'y ai pensé.
items.en: I thought about it.
items.respell: zhee ay pahⁿ-SAY
items.notes: The other pronoun, the same position, and the second word takes nothing at all, which is lesson 22 in A2's rule and holds here too.

items.fr: Je n'en ai pas parlé.
items.en: I did not talk about it.
items.respell: zhuh nahⁿ nay pah par-LAY
items.notes: The wrap and the past together: ne, pronoun, first word, pas, second word. Both rules, neither of them new.

items.fr: Il en rêve.
items.en: He dreams about it.
items.respell: eel ahⁿ REHV
items.notes: rêver DE quelque chose, and rêver is on no list in this lesson. English says "dreams ABOUT it", so the learner has a signal and it points at the wrong little word.

items.fr: On pourrait déjeuner ensemble jeudi.
items.en: We could have lunch together on Thursday.
items.respell: ohⁿ poo-reh day-zhuh-nay ahⁿ-sahⁿbl zhuh-DEE

items.fr: Ça te dirait de venir avec nous samedi ?
items.en: Would you fancy coming with us on Saturday?
items.ipa: /sa tə di.ʁɛ də və.niʁ a.vɛk nu sam.di/
items.respell: sah tuh dee-reh duh vuh-neer ah-vek noo sam-DEE

items.fr: Et si on prenait le train de sept heures ?
items.en: What if we took the seven o'clock train?
items.ipa: /e si ɔ̃ pʁə.nɛ lə tʁɛ̃ də sɛ.tœʁ/
items.respell: ay see ohⁿ pruh-neh luh trehⁿ duh seh-TUHR

items.fr: Ça vous dirait de passer boire un café après la réunion ?
items.en: Would you fancy coming for a coffee after the meeting?
items.ipa: /sa vu di.ʁɛ də pa.se bwaʁ œ̃ ka.fe a.pʁɛ la ʁe.y.njɔ̃/
items.respell: sah voo dee-reh duh pah-say bwar uhⁿ kah-fay ah-preh lah ray-ü-NYOHⁿ

items.fr: Il finit ici.
items.en: He finishes here.
items.respell: eel fee-nee ee-SEE
items.notes: The -IR third person, from lesson 3 in A2. Two letters after the stem, and they are silent as well.

items.fr: Je réponds vite.
items.en: I answer quickly.
items.respell: zhuh ray-pohⁿ VEET
items.notes: Ends in -ds, and the d and the s are both silent.

items.fr: Je perds mes clés.
items.en: I lose my keys.
items.respell: zhuh pehr may KLAY
items.notes: perdre keeps an r in the stem and loses the d out loud, exactly like the others.

items.fr: Je promets une réponse.
items.en: I promise an answer.
items.respell: zhuh proh-MEH ün ray-POHⁿS
items.notes: mets with a front on it, and one t, exactly as the head verb has one t here.

items.fr: Nous promettons une réponse.
items.en: We promise an answer.
items.respell: noo proh-meh-TOHⁿ ün ray-POHⁿS
items.notes: Two t, and the ending is the -ons you have written on every verb since lesson 1 in A2.

items.fr: Ils permettent ce choix.
items.en: They allow this choice.
items.respell: eel pehr-MET suh SHWAH
items.notes: Two t and a silent -ent, which is ils mettent with four letters in front of it.

items.fr: Je remets la clé.
items.en: I hand the key back.
items.respell: zhuh ruh-MEH la KLAY
items.notes: The same sentence as je mets la clé with two letters on the front, and the verb has not moved.

items.fr: Ils remettent la clé.
items.en: They hand the key back.
items.respell: eel ruh-MET la KLAY
items.notes: And the plural of the same. Read it above ils mettent la clé and count what changed.

items.fr: Ils combattent le feu.
items.en: They are fighting the fire.
items.respell: eel kohⁿ-BAT luh FUH
items.notes: battent with three letters in front. The only compound of this one you are likely to need.

items.fr: Tu apprends le français ici ?
items.en: Are you learning French here?
items.respell: tü a-PRAHⁿ luh frahⁿ-SEH ee-SEE
items.notes: The question that stops the scene, and the verb in it is one you can already build.

items.fr: Elles sont mortes en mars.
items.en: They died in March, and they are all women.
items.respell: ehl sohⁿ MORT ahⁿ MARSS

items.fr: Elle est restée à la maison.
items.en: She stayed at home.
items.respell: ehl eh res-TAY ah lah meh-ZOHⁿ

items.fr: Elle n’est pas allée au bureau.
items.en: She did not go to the office.
items.respell: ehl neh pah zah-LAY oh bü-ROH

items.fr: Nous ne sommes pas allés au bureau.
items.en: We did not go to the office.
items.ipa: /nu nə sɔm pa za.le o by.ʁo/
items.respell: noo nuh somm pah zah-LAY oh bü-ROH

items.fr: Elles ne sont pas allées au bureau.
items.en: They did not go to the office, and they are all women.
items.ipa: /ɛl nə sɔ̃ pa za.le o by.ʁo/
items.respell: ehl nuh sohⁿ pah zah-LAY oh bü-ROH

items.fr: Tu es allée où hier soir ?
items.en: Where did you go last night?
items.respell: tü eh tah-LAY oo yehr SWAHR

items.fr: Je suis sortie avec des amis.
items.en: I went out with friends.
items.respell: zhuh swee sor-TEE ah-vehk day zah-MEE

items.fr: Tu as sorti quoi ?
items.en: You took out what?
items.respell: tü ah sor-TEE KWAH

items.fr: Ah, avec des amis. Je comprends.
items.en: Ah, with friends. I see.
items.respell: ah ah-vehk day zah-MEE. zhuh kohⁿ-PRAHⁿ

items.fr: Tu es rentrée à quelle heure ?
items.en: What time did you get home?
items.respell: tü eh rahⁿ-TRAY ah keh-LUHR

items.fr: Je suis rentrée vers minuit.
items.en: I got home around midnight.
items.respell: zhuh swee rahⁿ-TRAY vehr mee-NWEE

items.fr: Vous êtes arrivés ensemble ?
items.en: Did you arrive together?
items.respell: voo zeht zah-ree-VAY ahⁿ-SAHⁿBL

items.fr: Nous sommes arrivés à huit heures.
items.en: We arrived at eight.
items.respell: noo somm zah-ree-VAY ah wee TUHR

items.fr: Ils les achètent.
items.en: They buy them.
items.respell: eel lay zah-SHEHT
items.notes: The ils cell, and the verb ending is silent, which lesson 1 in A2 owns and this lesson does not re-teach.

items.fr: Je l'invite.
items.en: I invite him.
items.respell: zhuh laⁿ-VEET
items.notes: A second elided verb, so the learner does not read the rule as a fact about aimer.

items.fr: Je l'achète.
items.en: I buy it.
items.respell: zhuh lah-SHEHT
items.notes: And a third, on a verb whose own vowel is the one causing the elision.

items.fr: Tu l'aimes.
items.en: You love her. Or him.
items.respell: tü LEM
items.notes: The same ambiguity in another person, so it is visibly a property of the form rather than of one sentence.

items.fr: Je les invite.
items.en: I invite them.
items.respell: zhuh lay zaⁿ-VEET
items.notes: The one that does NOT elide. les keeps its shape in front of a vowel and adds a z sound instead, so the plural survives where the singulars lose their gender.

items.fr: Je ne le vois pas.
items.en: I do not see it.
items.respell: zhuh nuh luh vwah PAH
items.notes: ne outside, pronoun and verb inside.

items.fr: Je ne les achète pas.
items.en: I do not buy them.
items.respell: zhuh nuh lay zah-sheht PAH
items.notes: The plural inside the wrap.

items.fr: Je ne l'aime pas.
items.en: I do not love him.
items.respell: zhuh nuh lem PAH
items.notes: The elided form inside the wrap.

items.fr: Je l'écoute.
items.en: I listen to it.
items.respell: zhuh lay-KOOT
items.notes: écouter is not taught here and not imported as a headword. The learner has it from lesson 28 in A1 and the position rule runs on it unchanged.

items.fr: Tu les cherches.
items.en: You are looking for them.
items.respell: tü lay SHEHRSH
items.notes: chercher, and the English needs a preposition where the French does not. Worth meeting once inside a sentence whose shape is already familiar.

items.fr: Elle le prend.
items.en: She takes it.
items.respell: ehl luh PRAHⁿ
items.notes: prendre is a2.15's, cell for cell, and nothing about carrying a pronoun is different for an irregular verb.

items.fr: Nous la finissons.
items.en: We finish it.
items.respell: noo lah fee-nee-SOHⁿ
items.notes: finir is lesson 3's, and its -iss- is its business and not this lesson's. The pronoun sits where it always sits.

items.fr: J'ai vu le film.
items.en: I saw the film.
items.respell: zhay vü luh FEELM
items.notes: The noun after the verb, so nothing happens to the second word. This is the baseline the agreement is measured against and it is lesson 16 in A2's sentence, not a new one.

items.fr: J'ai vu la photo.
items.en: I saw the photo.
items.respell: zhay vü lah foh-TOH
items.notes: The feminine noun, still after the verb, still no ending.

items.fr: J'ai acheté les livres.
items.en: I bought the books.
items.respell: zhay ahsh-TAY lay LEEVR
items.notes: Plural noun after the verb, no ending.

items.fr: J'ai regardé les photos.
items.en: I looked at the photos.
items.respell: zhay ruh-gar-DAY lay foh-TOH
items.notes: Feminine plural noun, after the verb, no ending. The fourth and last baseline.

items.fr: Je les ai regardées.
items.en: I looked at them.
items.respell: zhuh lay zay ruh-gar-DAY
items.notes: Feminine plural before the verb: two letters go on and neither is heard. RECEPTIVE ONLY, so no flashcard, no voiceflash and no dictation. A speak drill on this row would score a sound that carries none of the information.

items.fr: Oui, je la connais bien.
items.en: Yes, I know her well.
items.respell: wee, zhuh lah koh-neh BYEHⁿ
items.notes: Role play turn 1. The answer to a question about a person, which is where an English speaker reaches for "her" and puts it last.

items.fr: Nous ne les invitons pas.
items.en: We do not invite them.
items.respell: noo nuh lay zaⁿ-vee-tohⁿ PAH
items.notes: Kept for the reading and the speak list, where length is not a problem.

items.fr: C'est difficile à expliquer.
items.en: It is hard to explain.
items.respell: seh dee-fee-SEEL ah eks-plee-KAY
items.notes: Buys a second attempt rather than ending the turn. A doctor hearing it waits; a doctor hearing silence moves on.

items.fr: C'est combien de fois par jour ?
items.en: How many times a day is that?
items.respell: seh kohⁿ-byehⁿ duh fwah par ZHOOR
items.notes: The targeted question the disclaimer card ends on. It asks about the dose specifically rather than asking for the sentence again, which is lesson 24 in A2's move.

items.fr: J'ai mal ici, sous les côtes.
items.en: It hurts here, under the ribs.
items.respell: zhay mal ee-SEE soo lay KOHT
items.notes: Construction 1 with a location the learner points at. Sous is lesson 13 in A2's preposition and is used, not taught.

items.fr: J'ai mal partout.
items.en: I ache all over.
items.respell: zhay mal par-TOO
items.notes: Construction 1 with no body part at all, which is the shape lesson 27 in A1 never showed and the one a feverish person actually produces.

items.fr: Je lui prête un stylo.
items.en: I lend him a pen.
items.respell: zhuh lwee PREHT uhⁿ stee-LOH
items.notes: prêter is on no list in this lesson. English says "lend him" with nothing in between, so it belongs with the six and the learner has to work that out from the rule rather than from the table.

items.fr: Il lui promet.
items.en: He promises her.
items.respell: eel lwee proh-MEH
items.notes: promettre, an irregular verb from another lesson entirely, and nothing about carrying a pronoun is different for it.

items.fr: Nous lui obéissons.
items.en: We obey him.
items.respell: noo lwee oh-bay-ee-SOHⁿ
items.notes: obéir à quelqu'un, and it is the sharpest case in the lesson: English "obey him" has no preposition at all and French will not accept the direct version. A verb the lesson never showed, obeying the rule it did.

items.fr: Oui, je lui ai parlé hier.
items.en: Yes, I talked to him yesterday.
items.respell: wee, zhuh lwee ay par-LAY YEHR
items.notes: Role play turn 1, and the past straight away, because that is what somebody actually answers.

items.fr: Tu la connais aussi ?
items.en: Do you know her too?
items.respell: tü lah koh-NEH oh-SEE
items.notes: Lesson 22 in A1 owns the rising question and this borrows it without teaching it.

items.fr: Tu fais quoi cet après-midi ?
items.en: What are you doing this afternoon?
items.respell: tü feh KWAH seh-tah-preh-mee-DEE
items.notes: Cet stands in for ce before a vowel, and après-midi keeps its hyphen.

items.fr: Je reste chez moi.
items.en: I am staying at my place.
items.respell: zhuh REST shay MWAH

items.fr: Il est chez lui.
items.en: He is at his place.
items.respell: eel eh shay LÜEE
items.notes: The ü and the ee run together into one glide, the way lui always does.

items.fr: On mange chez Marie.
items.en: We are eating at Marie's.
items.respell: ohⁿ MAHⁿZH shay ma-REE
items.notes: On rather than nous, which is lesson 1 in A2's rule and the register this whole level uses.

items.fr: Je vais au Japon.
items.en: I am going to Japan.
items.respell: zhuh veh oh zhah-POHⁿ
items.notes: Au here is à plus le Japon, which is the same fold as au marché and nobody has ever said so.

items.fr: Elle est chez elle.
items.en: She is at her place.
items.respell: ehl eh shay EHL
items.notes: Fifteen letters, and the reason this row is authored rather than imported is that the only published « chez elle » carries the tie glyph that renders as an underscore on a phone.

items.fr: Je vais à la gare.
items.en: I am going to the station.
items.respell: zhuh veh ah lah GAHR
items.notes: Thirteen letters, and à la does not fold. Half of what lesson 24 in A1 gave you is the half where nothing happens.

items.fr: Je vais à l'hôpital.
items.en: I am going to the hospital.
items.respell: zhuh veh ah loh-pee-TAL
items.notes: Fifteen letters, because the apostrophe is not a letter. À l' does not fold either, and this is the building behind the doctor.

items.fr: Il vient de Nantes.
items.en: He is from Nantes.
items.respell: eel vyaⁿ duh NAHⁿT
items.notes: The same three words as Il vient de partir, and a completely different sentence.

items.fr: faire des progrès
items.en: to make progress
items.respell: FEHR day proh-GREH
items.notes: English makes progress and French does it. Nothing in the phrase can be worked out from either language.

items.fr: Non, je ne leur ai pas écrit.
items.en: No, I have not written to them.
items.ipa: /nɔ̃ ʒə nə lœʁ e pa e.kʁi/
items.respell: nohⁿ, zhuh nuh luhr ay pah zay-KREE

items.fr: Je vais lui téléphoner.
items.en: I am going to phone her.
items.respell: zhuh veh lwee tay-lay-foh-NAY
items.notes: In the futur proche the pronoun goes in front of the second verb, which is the one it belongs to.

items.fr: Vous seriez libre jeudi vers midi ?
items.en: Would you be free on Thursday around noon?
items.respell: voo suh-ryay leebr zhuh-dee vehr mee-DEE

items.fr: Ah, chez le médecin. Rien de grave ?
items.en: Ah, the doctor's. Nothing serious?
items.ipa: /a ʃe lə med.sɛ̃ ʁjɛ̃ də ɡʁav/
items.respell: ah shay luh mayd-SEHⁿ · RYEHⁿ duh GRAHV
items.notes: She supplies the word and moves straight on, which is what makes it expensive: nothing visibly went wrong.

items.fr: On se retrouve chez Marie ?
items.en: Shall we meet at Marie's?
items.respell: ohⁿ suh ruh-TROOV shay ma-REE
items.notes: A person, so chez and no article at all, because a name does not have one.

items.fr: Non, on se retrouve à la gare.
items.en: No, we are meeting at the station.
items.ipa: /nɔ̃ ɔ̃ sə ʁə.tʁuv a la ɡaʁ/
items.respell: nohⁿ ohⁿ suh ruh-TROOV ah lah GAHR
items.notes: And a place, so à and the article stays visible. Two turns, two kinds, one decision.

items.fr: Je couvre tout.
items.en: I cover everything.
items.respell: zhuh koovr TOO
items.notes: An -e ending, silent, exactly as on an -er verb.

items.fr: Il couvre tout.
items.en: He covers everything.
items.respell: eel koovr TOO
items.notes: Said exactly like Ils couvrent tout. Nothing in the sound separates them.

items.fr: Il ouvre à huit heures.
items.en: He opens at eight.
items.respell: ee-loovr a wee-TEUR
items.notes: The l of il links onto the vowel: ee-loovr, one word.

items.fr: Ils ouvrent à huit heures.
items.en: They open at eight.
items.respell: eel-zoovr a wee-TEUR
items.notes: The silent s of ils wakes up as a z. The verb did not change; the link did.

items.fr: Elle sent le café.
items.en: She can smell the coffee.
items.respell: el sahⁿ luh ka-FAY
items.notes: sentir ends in -tir and takes no -iss-. ralentir ends in -tir and takes one.

items.fr: Elles sentent le café.
items.en: They can smell the coffee.
items.respell: el sahⁿt luh ka-FAY
items.notes: The t comes back. Compare Les voitures ralentissent, where an -iss- comes instead.

items.fr: Il court vite.
items.en: He runs fast.
items.respell: eel koor VEET
items.notes: courir ends in -rir and takes no -iss-. guérir ends in -rir and takes one.

items.fr: Je sais que c'est loin.
items.en: I know it is far.
items.respell: zhuh SEH kuh seh LWAⁿ
items.notes: A second sentence hangs off the first one. Only savoir can hold it.

items.fr: Tu sais cuisiner ?
items.en: Do you know how to cook?
items.respell: tü SEH kwee-zee-NAY
items.notes: A different verb behind savoir and nothing else moves. The rising voice makes it a question, as it did in lesson 22 in A1.

items.fr: Elle sait conduire.
items.en: She knows how to drive.
items.respell: ell SEH kohⁿ-DWEER
items.notes: English says she can drive, and French does not use its can verb here at all.

items.fr: Vous savez où est la gare ?
items.en: Do you know where the station is?
items.respell: voo sa-VAY oo eh la GAR
items.notes: The single most useful sentence in the lesson, and it is a place taking savoir again.

items.fr: Il connaît bien la ville.
items.en: He knows the city well.
items.respell: eel koh-NEH byaⁿ la VEEL
items.notes: bien slides in before the thing and changes nothing. The sentence still lands on la ville.

items.fr: Vous connaissez cette chanson ?
items.en: Do you know this song?
items.respell: voo koh-neh-SAY set shahⁿ-SOHⁿ
items.notes: A song is a thing you have heard, so it is connaître. Knowing the words would be too.

items.fr: Je peux nager.
items.en: I can swim.
items.respell: zhuh PUH nah-ZHAY
items.notes: Nothing is stopping me. It says nothing at all about whether I ever learned.

items.fr: On peut nager ici.
items.en: You can swim here.
items.respell: ohⁿ PUH nah-ZHAY ee-SEE
items.notes: Swimming is allowed here. Nobody is claiming anybody has been taught.

items.fr: Je sais nager, mais je ne peux pas aujourd'hui.
items.en: I know how to swim, but I cannot today.
items.ipa: /ʒə sɛ na.ʒe mɛ ʒə nə pø pa o.ʒuʁ.dɥi/
items.respell: zhuh SEH nah-ZHAY, meh zhuh nuh puh pa oh-zhoor-DWEE
items.notes: Both verbs in one sentence, and they are not saying the same thing about the same swimmer.

items.fr: Je connais ce quartier, mais je ne sais pas où est la gare.
items.en: I know this neighbourhood, but I do not know where the station is.
items.ipa: /ʒə kɔ.nɛ sə kaʁ.tje mɛ ʒə nə sɛ pa u ɛ la ɡaʁ/
items.respell: zhuh koh-NEH suh kar-TYAY, meh zhuh nuh SEH pa oo eh la GAR
items.notes: One place, both verbs, and the choice is made twice by what comes after each one.

items.fr: Tu connais la nouvelle voisine ?
items.en: Have you met the new neighbour?
items.respell: tü koh-NEH la noo-VELL vwah-ZEEN
items.notes: A person follows, so it is connaître, and the question is whether you have met her.

items.fr: Oui, je sais qu'elle habite ici.
items.en: Yes, I know that she lives here.
items.respell: wee, zhuh SEH kell ah-BEET ee-SEE
items.notes: Correct French, and it answers a question nobody asked. It says you have heard about her, not that you have met her.

items.fr: Non, je ne connais pas encore la voisine.
items.en: No, I have not met the neighbour yet.
items.ipa: /nɔ̃ ʒə nə kɔ.nɛ pa ɑ̃.kɔʁ la vwa.zin/
items.respell: nohⁿ, zhuh nuh koh-NEH pa ahⁿ-KOR la vwah-ZEEN
items.notes: The answer the question was asking for. It still lands on a person, even with the negative wrapped round the verb.

items.fr: Je reconnais cette chanson.
items.en: I recognise this song.
items.respell: zhuh ruh-koh-NEH set shahⁿ-SOHⁿ
items.notes: Same endings as connais, with three letters in front. What it can take after it is lesson 9 in A2's business, not this lesson's.

items.fr: On vient de finir.
items.en: We have just finished.
items.respell: ohⁿ vyaⁿ duh fee-NEER
items.notes: on means we and takes the il form, so the spoken we says vient here and never venons.

items.fr: Nous venons de vendre la maison.
items.en: We have just sold the house.
items.respell: noo vuh-nohⁿ duh vahⁿdr lah meh-ZOHⁿ
items.notes: The written we. Longer than the sixteen letters a dictée can spell, so it is spoken here and not written.

items.fr: Ils viennent d'arriver.
items.en: They have just arrived.
items.respell: eel vyenn dar-ee-VAY
items.notes: The de elides in front of a vowel, which lesson 8 in Sounds already taught. The construction did not change; the spelling of one word did.

items.fr: Je viens de Paris.
items.en: I am from Paris.
items.respell: zhuh vyaⁿ duh pa-REE
items.notes: Word for word the same as Je viens de manger until the fourth word. A place after de is where you are from.

items.fr: Ils viennent de Paris.
items.en: They are from Paris.
items.respell: eel vyenn duh pa-REE
items.notes: The plural does it too, and the plural of the other one sounds identical up to de as well.

items.fr: Il obtient la clé.
items.en: He gets the key.
items.respell: ee lohb-tyaⁿ lah KLAY
items.notes: Il tient la clé with ob- on the front. The l of il moves across because the verb now starts with a vowel.

items.fr: Je fais le lit.
items.en: I make the bed.
items.respell: zhuh FEH luh LEE
items.notes: fais, and it sounds exactly like tu fais and il fait. Only the pronoun separates the three.

items.fr: Tu fais le lit.
items.en: You make the bed.
items.respell: tü FEH luh LEE
items.notes: The same spelling as the je form and the same sound. The -s is silent, as it has been on every verb since lesson 1 in A2.

items.fr: Il fait le lit.
items.en: He makes the bed.
items.respell: eel FEH luh LEE
items.notes: The third of three spellings that are one sound. This is also the form the weather uses, with nobody doing anything.

items.fr: Nous faisons le lit.
items.en: We make the bed.
items.respell: noo fuh-ZOHⁿ luh LEE
items.notes: Written fais- and said fuh-. It is the one place in the language where ai is not the eh sound, and the ending itself is the ordinary one.

items.fr: Vous faites le lit.
items.en: You make the bed.
items.respell: voo FEHT luh LEE
items.notes: Not faisez. This is one of three verbs in the language where vous does not end in -ez, and it is the most-corrected form at this level.

items.fr: Ils font le lit.
items.en: They make the bed.
items.respell: eel FOHⁿ luh LEE
items.notes: Not faisent. It joins sont, ont and vont, and those four are the whole of the -ont list.

items.fr: Je dis bonjour.
items.en: I say hello.
items.respell: zhuh DEE bohⁿ-ZHOOR
items.notes: dis, and the same three-spellings-one-sound as on faire. Nothing at the end of the verb is said at all.

items.fr: Tu dis bonjour.
items.en: You say hello.
items.respell: tü DEE bohⁿ-ZHOOR
items.notes: Spelled like the je form and said like it. Put the pronoun in and the sentence is unambiguous.

items.fr: Il dit bonjour.
items.en: He says hello.
items.respell: eel DEE bohⁿ-ZHOOR
items.notes: The -t is silent. Compare Il fait le lit: the two verbs behave identically here.

items.fr: Nous disons bonjour.
items.en: We say hello.
items.respell: noo dee-ZOHⁿ bohⁿ-ZHOOR
items.notes: The ordinary -ons, on a stem that has not moved. Out loud most rooms say on dit instead.

items.fr: Vous dites bonjour.
items.en: You say hello.
items.respell: voo DEET bohⁿ-ZHOOR
items.notes: Not disez. The second of the three -tes forms, and the -s of the stem is heard here as a t.

items.fr: Je lis le menu.
items.en: I read the menu.
items.respell: zhuh LEE luh muh-NÜ
items.notes: The same shape as je dis and je fais. All three verbs agree in the singular and part company in the plural.

items.fr: Tu lis le menu.
items.en: You read the menu.
items.respell: tü LEE luh muh-NÜ
items.notes: Silent -s, as everywhere else. Nothing here is new.

items.fr: Il lit le menu.
items.en: He reads the menu.
items.respell: eel LEE luh muh-NÜ
items.notes: Silent -t. Three verbs, three singulars, and not one audible difference between the persons.

items.fr: Nous lisons le menu.
items.en: We read the menu.
items.respell: noo lee-ZOHⁿ luh muh-NÜ
items.notes: This form does not appear once in the whole published corpus, and the pattern still tells you what it is.

items.fr: Vous lisez le menu.
items.en: You read the menu.
items.respell: voo lee-ZAY luh muh-NÜ
items.notes: The -ez you have had since lesson 1 in A2, and this is the cell that shows the other two are the exception rather than the rule.

items.fr: Ils lisent le menu.
items.en: They read the menu.
items.respell: eel LEEZ luh muh-NÜ
items.notes: The ordinary -ent, silent as always, with the z of the stem in front of it.

items.fr: il vaudrait mieux
items.en: it would be better
items.respell: eel voh-dreh MYUH

items.fr: tu ferais mieux de
items.en: you would do better to
items.respell: tü fuh-reh MYUH duh

items.fr: volontiers
items.en: gladly
items.respell: voh-lohⁿ-TYAY

items.fr: Si le train est en retard, nous attendrons à la gare.
items.en: If the train is late, we will wait at the station.
items.ipa: /si lə tʁɛ̃ ɛ.tɑ̃ ʁə.taʁ nu.za.tɑ̃.dʁɔ̃ a la ɡaʁ/
items.respell: see luh trehⁿ eh-tahⁿ ruh-TAR | noo-za-tahⁿ-DROHⁿ a la GAR

items.fr: Si tout le monde arrive à l'heure, nous partirons à huit heures.
items.en: If everyone arrives on time, we will leave at eight.
items.ipa: /si tu lə mɔ̃d a.ʁiv a lœʁ nu paʁ.ti.ʁɔ̃ a ɥi.tœʁ/
items.respell: see too luh mohⁿd a-reev a LEUR | noo par-tee-ROHⁿ a wee-TEUR

items.fr: Si la salle est libre, la réunion aura lieu au premier étage.
items.en: If the room is free, the meeting will be held on the first floor.
items.ipa: /si la sal ɛ libʁ la ʁe.y.njɔ̃ o.ʁa ljø o pʁə.mje.ʁe.taʒ/
items.respell: see la sal eh LEEBR | la ray-ü-NYOHⁿ oh-ra lyuh oh pruh-myay-ray-TAZH

items.fr: Si je trouve un remplaçant, je prendrai ma journée de lundi.
items.en: If I find a replacement, I will take Monday off.
items.ipa: /si ʒə tʁuv œ̃ ʁɑ̃.pla.sɑ̃ ʒə pʁɑ̃.dʁe ma ʒuʁ.ne də lœ̃.di/
items.respell: see zhuh troov uhⁿ rahⁿ-pla-SAHⁿ | zhuh prahⁿ-DREH ma zhoor-nay duh luhⁿ-DEE

items.fr: Si elle finit son rapport ce soir, elle sera tranquille demain.
items.en: If she finishes her report tonight, she will be free tomorrow.
items.ipa: /si ɛl fi.ni sɔ̃ ʁa.pɔʁ sə swaʁ ɛl sə.ʁa tʁɑ̃.kil də.mɛ̃/
items.respell: see el fee-nee sohⁿ ra-por suh SWAR | el suh-ra trahⁿ-KEEL duh-MEHⁿ

items.fr: Si nous n'avons pas de réponse, nous rappellerons mardi.
items.en: If we have no answer, we will call back on Tuesday.
items.ipa: /si nu na.vɔ̃ pa də ʁe.pɔ̃s nu ʁa.pɛl.ʁɔ̃ maʁ.di/
items.respell: see noo na-vohⁿ pa duh ray-POHⁿS | noo ra-pel-ROHⁿ mar-DEE

items.fr: Si le magasin est fermé, j'irai au marché.
items.en: If the shop is closed, I will go to the market.
items.ipa: /si lə ma.ɡa.zɛ̃ ɛ fɛʁ.me ʒi.ʁe o maʁ.ʃe/
items.respell: see luh ma-ga-zehⁿ eh fehr-MAY | zhee-REH oh mar-SHAY

items.fr: Si les enfants sont fatigués, nous rentrerons plus tôt.
items.en: If the children are tired, we will go home earlier.
items.ipa: /si le.zɑ̃.fɑ̃ sɔ̃ fa.ti.ɡe nu ʁɑ̃.tʁə.ʁɔ̃ ply to/
items.respell: see lay-zahⁿ-fahⁿ sohⁿ fa-tee-GAY | noo rahⁿ-truh-ROHⁿ plü TOH

items.fr: Si tu oublies ton badge, tu devras passer à l'accueil.
items.en: If you forget your badge, you will have to go to reception.
items.ipa: /si ty u.bli tɔ̃ badʒ ty də.vʁa pa.se a la.kœj/
items.respell: see tü oo-blee tohⁿ BADZH | tü duh-VRA pa-say a la-KEUY

items.fr: Après si, le présent. C'est l'autre moitié qui prend le futur.
items.en: After si, the present. The other half is the one that takes the future.
items.ipa: /a.pʁɛ si lə pʁe.zɑ̃ sɛ lotʁ mwa.tje ki pʁɑ̃ lə fy.tyʁ/
items.respell: a-preh see luh pray-ZAHⁿ | seh lohtr mwa-tyay kee prahⁿ luh fü-TÜR
items.prompt: Une condition réelle : quel temps juste après si ?

items.fr: Si tu veux, je peux te déposer à la gare.
items.en: If you like, I can drop you at the station.

items.ipa: /a.vɛk sɛt ɡʁip ʒə sɥi ma.lad kɔ.mœ̃ ʃjɛ̃/
items.respell: a-vehk seht GREEP zhuh swee ma-LAD ko-muhⁿ SHYEHⁿ

items.fr: Les enfants dorment comme des loirs.
items.en: The children are sleeping like logs.
items.respell: lay-zahⁿ-FAHⁿ DORM kom day LWAR

items.fr: Il a une fièvre de cheval, appelle le médecin.
items.en: He has a raging fever, call the doctor.
items.ipa: /i.la yn fjɛvʁ də ʃə.val a.pɛl lə med.sɛ̃/
items.respell: ee-la ün FYEHVR duh shuh-VAL a-pehl luh mehd-SEHⁿ

items.fr: il y a anguille sous roche
items.en: something fishy is going on
items.respell: ee-lya ahⁿ-GEEY soo ROSH
items.notes: Image : une anguille cachée sous une pierre. Sens : on nous cache quelque chose. L'anglais dit fishy, sans anguille. EN: something fishy is going on.

items.fr: Occupe-toi de tes oignons, s'il te plaît.
items.en: Mind your own business, please.
items.ipa: /ɔ.kyp twa də te.zɔ.ɲɔ̃ sil tə plɛ/
items.respell: o-küp twa duh tay-zo-NYOHⁿ seel tuh PLEH

items.fr: noyer le poisson
items.en: to cloud the issue
items.respell: nwa-YAY luh pwa-SOHⁿ
items.notes: Image : noyer un poisson, ce qui est impossible. Sens : parler d'autre chose pour ne pas répondre. EN: to cloud the issue.

items.fr: faire l'autruche
items.en: to bury your head in the sand
items.respell: fehr loh-TRÜSH
items.notes: Image : l'autruche qui cache sa tête dans le sable. Sens : refuser de voir un problème. L'anglais décrit le geste, sans nommer l'oiseau. EN: to bury your head in the sand.

items.fr: Arrête de me raconter des salades.
items.en: Stop telling me tall stories.
items.respell: a-reht duh muh ra-kohⁿ-TAY day sa-LAD

items.fr: Ils chuchotent depuis ce matin, il y a anguille sous roche.
items.en: They have been whispering since this morning, something is up.
items.ipa: /il ʃy.ʃɔt də.pɥi sə ma.tɛ̃ i.lja ɑ̃.ɡij su ʁɔʃ/
items.respell: eel shü-SHOT duh-pwee suh ma-TEHⁿ ee-lya ahⁿ-GEEY soo ROSH

items.fr: Le ministre a noyé le poisson.
items.en: The minister dodged the question.
items.respell: luh mee-NEESTR a nwa-yay luh pwa-SOHⁿ

items.fr: Tu ne peux pas faire l'autruche toute ta vie.
items.en: You cannot bury your head in the sand all your life.
items.ipa: /ty nə pø pa fɛʁ lo.tʁyʃ tut ta vi/
items.respell: tü nuh peu pa fehr loh-TRÜSH toot ta VEE

items.fr: Je ne sais pas, je donne ma langue au chat.
items.en: I do not know, I give up.
items.ipa: /ʒə nə sɛ pa ʒə dɔn ma lɑ̃ɡ o ʃa/
items.respell: zhuh nuh seh PA zhuh don ma LAHⁿG oh SHA

items.fr: Ce n'est qu'une tache, n'en fais pas tout un fromage.
items.en: It is only a stain, do not make a fuss about it.
items.ipa: /sə nɛ kyn taʃ nɑ̃ fɛ pa tu.tœ̃ fʁɔ.maʒ/
items.respell: suh neh kün TASH nahⁿ feh pa too-tuhⁿ fro-MAZH

items.fr: Il raconte des salades à tout le monde.
items.en: He tells tall stories to everybody.
items.ipa: /il ʁa.kɔ̃t de sa.lad a tu lə mɔ̃d/
items.respell: eel ra-KOHⁿT day sa-LAD a too luh MOHⁿD

items.fr: Quand je pose la question, elle noie le poisson.
items.en: When I ask the question, she changes the subject.
items.ipa: /kɑ̃ ʒə poz la kɛs.tjɔ̃ ɛl nwa lə pwa.sɔ̃/
items.respell: kahⁿ zhuh pohz la kehs-TYOHⁿ ehl nwa luh pwa-SOHⁿ

items.fr: Tu donnes ta langue au chat ?
items.en: Do you give up?
items.respell: tü don ta LAHⁿG oh SHA

items.fr: Il a fait l'autruche et la facture a doublé.
items.en: He buried his head in the sand and the bill doubled.
items.ipa: /i.la fɛ lo.tʁyʃ e la fak.tyʁ a du.ble/
items.respell: ee-la feh loh-TRÜSH ay la fak-TÜR a doo-BLAY

items.fr: ce n'est pas de la tarte
items.en: it is no picnic
items.respell: suh neh pad la TART
items.notes: Image : ce n'est pas une tarte, douce et facile. Sens : c'est difficile. À l'oral : c'est pas de la tarte. EN: it is no picnic.

items.fr: avoir du pain sur la planche
items.en: to have a lot on your plate
items.respell: a-vwar dü PEHⁿ sür la PLAHⁿSH
items.notes: Image : du pain qui attend sur la planche du boulanger. Sens : avoir beaucoup de travail devant soi. EN: to have a lot on your plate.

items.fr: marcher sur des œufs
items.en: to walk on eggshells
items.respell: mar-SHAY sür day-ZEU
items.notes: Image : marcher sur des œufs sans les casser. Sens : faire très attention à ce qu'on dit. L'anglais garde les coquilles. EN: to walk on eggshells.

items.fr: ça ne mange pas de pain
items.en: there is no harm in trying
items.respell: sa nuh mahⁿzh pad PEHⁿ
items.notes: Image : ça ne coûte même pas un morceau de pain. Sens : ça ne coûte rien d'essayer. EN: there is no harm in trying.

items.fr: courir comme une poule pas de tête
items.en: to run around like a headless chicken
items.respell: koo-REER kom ün POOL pad TEHT
items.notes: Image : une poule qui court partout sans tête. Sens : courir dans tous les sens, sans organisation. La forme du Québec. EN: to run around like a headless chicken.

items.fr: courir comme un poulet sans tête
items.en: to run around like a headless chicken
items.respell: koo-REER ko-muhⁿ poo-LEH sahⁿ TEHT
items.notes: Image : la même. Sens : le même. La forme de France. EN: to run around like a headless chicken.

items.fr: L'examen de conduite, c'est du gâteau.
items.en: The driving test is a piece of cake.
items.respell: lehg-za-MEHⁿ duh kohⁿ-DWEET seh dü ga-TOH

items.fr: Trouver un appartement à Montréal, ce n'est pas de la tarte.
items.en: Finding a flat in Montréal is no picnic.
items.ipa: /tʁu.ve œ̃.na.paʁ.tə.mɑ̃ a mɔ̃.ʁe.al sə nɛ pad la taʁt/
items.respell: troo-VAY uhⁿ-na-par-tuh-MAHⁿ a mohⁿ-ray-AL suh neh pad la TART

items.fr: Cette semaine, j'ai du pain sur la planche.
items.en: This week I have a lot on my plate.
items.ipa: /sɛt sə.mɛn ʒe dy pɛ̃ syʁ la plɑ̃ʃ/
items.respell: seht suh-MEN zhay dü PEHⁿ sür la PLAHⁿSH

items.fr: Avec mon beau-père, je marche sur des œufs.
items.en: With my stepfather I walk on eggshells.
items.ipa: /a.vɛk mɔ̃ bo.pɛʁ ʒə maʁʃ syʁ de.zø/
items.respell: a-vehk mohⁿ boh-PEHR zhuh marsh sür day-ZEU

items.fr: Demande-lui, ça ne mange pas de pain.
items.en: Ask him, there is no harm in asking.
items.ipa: /də.mɑ̃d lɥi sa nə mɑ̃ʒ pad pɛ̃/
items.respell: duh-mahⁿd LWEE sa nuh mahⁿzh pad PEHⁿ

items.fr: Le lundi, je cours comme une poule pas de tête.
items.en: On Mondays I run around like a headless chicken.
items.ipa: /lə lœ̃.di ʒə kuʁ kɔm yn pul pad tɛt/
items.respell: luh luhⁿ-DEE zhuh KOOR kom ün POOL pad TEHT

items.fr: Pour toi, ce sera du gâteau.
items.en: For you it will be a piece of cake.
items.respell: poor TWA suh suh-ra dü ga-TOH

items.fr: On a du pain sur la planche avant le déménagement.
items.en: We have a lot to do before the move.
items.ipa: /ɔ̃.na dy pɛ̃ syʁ la plɑ̃ʃ a.vɑ̃ lə de.me.naʒ.mɑ̃/
items.respell: ohⁿ-na dü PEHⁿ sür la PLAHⁿSH a-vahⁿ luh day-may-nazh-MAHⁿ

items.fr: Depuis leur dispute, tout le monde marche sur des œufs.
items.en: Since their argument everybody walks on eggshells.
items.ipa: /də.pɥi lœʁ dis.pyt tu lə mɔ̃d maʁʃ syʁ de.zø/

items.fr: Essaie, ça ne mange pas de pain.
items.en: Try, it costs nothing.
items.respell: ay-SEH sa nuh mahⁿzh pad PEHⁿ

items.fr: têtu comme une mule
items.en: stubborn as a mule
items.respell: tay-TÜ kom ün MÜL
items.notes: Image : une mule qui refuse d'avancer. Sens : très têtu. L'anglais garde la même image. EN: stubborn as a mule.

items.fr: malin comme un singe
items.en: sharp as a tack
items.respell: ma-LEHⁿ ko-muhⁿ SEHⁿZH
items.notes: Image : un singe qui trouve toujours une astuce. Sens : très malin, débrouillard. Au féminin : maligne. EN: sharp as a tack.

items.fr: myope comme une taupe
items.en: blind as a bat
items.respell: MYOP kom ün TOHP
items.notes: Image : la taupe, qui vit sous la terre et voit mal. Sens : voir très mal. L'anglais met une chauve-souris. EN: blind as a bat.

items.fr: haut comme trois pommes
items.en: knee-high to a grasshopper
items.respell: oh kom trwa POM
items.notes: Image : trois pommes l'une sur l'autre. Sens : tout petit, pour un enfant. L'anglais met une sauterelle. EN: knee-high to a grasshopper.

items.fr: bavard comme une pie
items.en: a real chatterbox
items.respell: ba-VAR kom ün PEE
items.notes: Image : la pie, un oiseau qui crie sans arrêt. Sens : qui parle tout le temps. EN: a real chatterbox.

items.fr: fort comme un bœuf
items.en: strong as an ox
items.respell: FOR ko-muhⁿ BUHF
items.notes: Image : un bœuf qui tire une charrette. Sens : très fort. L'anglais garde la même image. EN: strong as an ox.

items.fr: doux comme un agneau
items.en: gentle as a lamb
items.respell: doo ko-muhⁿ-na-NYOH
items.notes: Image : un petit agneau. Sens : très doux, jamais méchant. L'anglais garde la même image. EN: gentle as a lamb.

items.fr: rusé comme un renard
items.en: sly as a fox
items.respell: rü-ZAY ko-muhⁿ ruh-NAR
items.notes: Image : le renard des contes, qui trompe tout le monde. Sens : très rusé. L'anglais garde la même image. EN: sly as a fox.

items.fr: Mon père est têtu comme une mule.
items.en: My father is as stubborn as a mule.
items.ipa: /mɔ̃ pɛʁ ɛ te.ty kɔm yn myl/
items.respell: mohⁿ PEHR eh tay-TÜ kom ün MÜL

items.fr: Ta nièce est maligne comme un singe.
items.en: Your niece is sharp as a tack.
items.respell: ta NYEHS eh ma-LEEÑ ko-muhⁿ SEHⁿZH

items.fr: Sans lunettes, je suis myope comme une taupe.
items.en: Without my glasses I am blind as a bat.
items.ipa: /sɑ̃ ly.nɛt ʒə sɥi mjɔp kɔm yn top/
items.respell: sahⁿ lü-NEHT zhuh swee MYOP kom ün TOHP

items.fr: Je te connais depuis que tu es haut comme trois pommes.
items.en: I have known you since you were knee-high.

items.fr: Ma voisine est bavarde comme une pie.
items.en: My neighbour is a real chatterbox.
items.ipa: /ma vwa.zin ɛ ba.vaʁd kɔm yn pi/
items.respell: ma vwa-ZEEN eh ba-VARD kom ün PEE

items.fr: Il porte le frigo seul, il est fort comme un bœuf.
items.en: He carries the fridge on his own, he is strong as an ox.

items.fr: Leur chien est doux comme un agneau.
items.en: Their dog is as gentle as a lamb.
items.respell: luhr SHYEHⁿ eh doo ko-muhⁿ-na-NYOH

items.fr: Attention, le vendeur est rusé comme un renard.
items.en: Careful, the salesman is sly as a fox.
items.ipa: /a.tɑ̃.sjɔ̃ lə vɑ̃.dœʁ ɛ ʁy.ze kɔ.mœ̃ ʁə.naʁ/
items.respell: a-tahⁿ-SYOHⁿ luh vahⁿ-DUHR eh rü-ZAY ko-muhⁿ ruh-NAR

items.fr: Ma grand-mère est têtue comme une mule.
items.en: My grandmother is as stubborn as a mule.
items.ipa: /ma ɡʁɑ̃.mɛʁ ɛ te.ty kɔm yn myl/
items.respell: ma grahⁿ-MEHR eh tay-TÜ kom ün MÜL

items.fr: Leur fils est haut comme trois pommes.
items.en: Their son is knee-high to a grasshopper.
items.ipa: /lœʁ fis ɛ o kɔm tʁwa pɔm/
items.respell: luhr FEES eh oh kom trwa POM

items.fr: occupe-toi de tes oignons
items.en: mind your own business
items.respell: o-küp twa duh tay-zo-NYOHⁿ
items.notes: Image : va t'occuper de ton jardin, de tes oignons. Sens : ne te mêle pas de ça. Jamais avec un patron. EN: mind your own business.

items.fr: mettre son grain de sel
items.en: to put your two cents in
items.respell: mehtr sohⁿ grehⁿd SEHL
items.notes: Image : ajouter son grain de sel dans le plat d'un autre. Sens : donner son avis quand personne ne l'a demandé. EN: to put your two cents in.

items.fr: couper la poire en deux
items.en: to split the difference
items.respell: koo-PAY la PWAR ahⁿ DEU
items.notes: Image : une poire, une moitié chacun. Sens : faire un compromis, chacun fait la moitié du chemin. EN: to split the difference.

items.fr: ménager la chèvre et le chou
items.en: to keep both sides happy
items.respell: may-na-ZHAY la SHEHVR ay luh SHOO
items.notes: Image : garder la chèvre ET le chou, alors que la chèvre veut manger le chou. Sens : ne fâcher personne. Pas d'image en anglais. EN: to keep both sides happy.

items.fr: revenons à nos moutons
items.en: let's get back to the point
items.respell: ruh-vuh-NOHⁿ a noh moo-TOHⁿ
items.notes: Image : un berger qui retourne à ses moutons. Sens : revenons au vrai sujet. Pas d'image en anglais. EN: let's get back to the point.

items.fr: Mon oncle met toujours son grain de sel.
items.en: My uncle always sticks his oar in.
items.respell: mohⁿ-NOHⁿKL meh too-zhoor sohⁿ grehⁿd SEHL

items.fr: Désolé, j'ai d'autres chats à fouetter.
items.en: Sorry, I have other fish to fry.
items.respell: day-zo-LAY zhay doh-truh SHA a fweh-TAY

items.fr: Tu veux quarante dollars, moi trente : coupons la poire en deux.
items.en: You want forty dollars, I want thirty: let us split the difference.

items.respell: tü veu ka-rahⁿt do-LAR mwa TRAHⁿT koo-pohⁿ la PWAR ahⁿ DEU

items.en: The manager keeps both sides happy.

items.respell: luh dee-rehk-TUHR may-NAZH la SHEHVR ay luh SHOO

items.en: Right, back to the point.
items.respell: bohⁿ ruh-vuh-NOHⁿ a noh moo-TOHⁿ

items.en: Do not stick your oar into their argument.
items.ipa: /nə mɛ pa tɔ̃ ɡʁɛ̃d sɛl dɑ̃ lœʁ dis.pyt/
items.respell: nuh meh pa tohⁿ grehⁿd SEHL dahⁿ luhr dees-PÜT

items.en: We split the difference: each of us pays half.
items.ipa: /ɔ̃.na ku.pe la pwaʁ ɑ̃ dø ʃa.kœ̃ pɛ la mwa.tje/
items.respell: ohⁿ-na koo-PAY la PWAR ahⁿ DEU sha-kuhⁿ peh la mwa-TYAY

items.fr: Elle a d'autres chats à fouetter que tes histoires.
items.en: She has better things to do than your stories.
items.ipa: /ɛ.la do.tʁə ʃa a fwɛ.te kə te.zis.twaʁ/
items.respell: eh-la doh-truh SHA a fweh-TAY kuh tay-zees-TWAR

items.fr: Excusez-moi, revenons à nos moutons : le budget.
items.en: Excuse me, back to the point: the budget.
items.ipa: /ɛks.ky.ze mwa ʁə.və.nɔ̃ a no mu.tɔ̃ lə byd.ʒɛ/
items.respell: ehks-kü-zay MWA ruh-vuh-NOHⁿ a noh moo-TOHⁿ luh büd-ZHEH

items.fr: la cerise sur le gâteau
items.en: the icing on the cake
items.respell: la suh-REEZ sür luh ga-TOH
items.notes: Image : la cerise posée tout en haut du gâteau. Sens : le petit plus qui rend une bonne chose parfaite. L'anglais met du glaçage. EN: the icing on the cake.

items.fr: mettre du beurre dans les épinards
items.en: to make life a bit easier
items.respell: mehtr dü BUHR dahⁿ lay-zay-pee-NAR
items.notes: Image : du beurre qui rend les épinards meilleurs. Sens : un peu plus d'argent, qui rend la vie plus facile. EN: to make life a bit easier.

items.fr: les carottes sont cuites
items.en: the game is up
items.respell: lay ka-ROT sohⁿ KWEET
items.notes: Image : des carottes trop cuites, on ne peut plus rien changer. Sens : c'est fini, c'est perdu. EN: the game is up.

items.fr: c'est la fin des haricots
items.en: that is the last straw
items.respell: seh la fehⁿ day a-ree-KOH
items.notes: Image : plus un haricot dans la marmite. Sens : c'est la catastrophe, il ne reste plus rien. Souvent pour rire. EN: that is the last straw.

items.fr: vendre la peau de l'ours avant de l'avoir tué

items.ipa: /vɑ̃dʁ la po də luʁs a.vɑ̃d la.vwaʁ tɥe/
items.respell: vahⁿdr la POH duh LOORS a-vahⁿd la-vwar TWAY
items.notes: Image : vendre la peau d'un ours qu'on n'a pas encore attrapé. Sens : fêter trop tôt. L'anglais compte des poussins. EN: do not count your chickens before they hatch.

items.fr: Il a eu le poste, et le salaire, c'est la cerise sur le gâteau.
items.en: He got the job, and the salary is the icing on the cake.
items.ipa: /i.la y lə pɔst e lə sa.lɛʁ sɛ la sə.ʁiz syʁ lə ɡɑ.to/
items.respell: ee-la ü luh POST ay luh sa-LEHR seh la suh-REEZ sür luh ga-TOH

items.fr: Ce petit contrat met du beurre dans les épinards.
items.en: This small contract makes life a bit easier.
items.ipa: /sə pə.ti kɔ̃.tʁa mɛ dy bœʁ dɑ̃ le.ze.pi.naʁ/
items.respell: suh puh-tee kohⁿ-TRA meh dü BUHR dahⁿ lay-zay-pee-NAR

items.fr: Le train est parti sans nous, les carottes sont cuites.
items.en: The train left without us, that is that.

items.respell: luh TREHⁿ eh par-tee sahⁿ NOO lay ka-ROT sohⁿ KWEET

items.fr: Plus de café au bureau, c'est la fin des haricots.
items.en: No more coffee at the office, that is the last straw.
items.ipa: /plyd ka.fe o by.ʁo sɛ la fɛ̃ de a.ʁi.ko/
items.respell: plüd ka-FAY oh bü-ROH seh la fehⁿ day a-ree-KOH

items.fr: Ne vends pas la peau de l'ours avant de l'avoir tué.
items.en: Do not count your chickens before they hatch.
items.ipa: /nə vɑ̃ pa la po də luʁs a.vɑ̃d la.vwaʁ tɥe/
items.respell: nuh vahⁿ pa la POH duh LOORS a-vahⁿd la-vwar TWAY

items.fr: Et la cerise sur le gâteau : il fait beau.
items.en: And the icing on the cake: the weather is fine.
items.ipa: /e la sə.ʁiz syʁ lə ɡɑ.to il fɛ bo/
items.respell: ay la suh-REEZ sür luh ga-TOH eel feh BOH

items.fr: Un deuxième emploi, ça met du beurre dans les épinards.
items.en: A second job makes life a bit easier.
items.ipa: /œ̃ dø.zjɛm ɑ̃.plwa sa mɛ dy bœʁ dɑ̃ le.ze.pi.naʁ/
items.respell: uhⁿ deu-ZYEM ahⁿ-PLWA sa meh dü BUHR dahⁿ lay-zay-pee-NAR

items.fr: On perd trois à zéro, les carottes sont cuites.
items.en: We are three nil down, it is all over.
items.ipa: /ɔ̃ pɛʁ tʁwa a ze.ʁo le ka.ʁɔt sɔ̃ kɥit/
items.respell: ohⁿ PEHR trwa a zay-ROH lay ka-ROT sohⁿ KWEET

items.fr: Il n'a pas encore signé, ne vendons pas la peau de l'ours.
items.en: He has not signed yet, let us not count our chickens.
items.ipa: /il na pa.zɑ̃.kɔʁ si.ɲe nə vɑ̃.dɔ̃ pa la po də luʁs/
items.respell: eel na pa-zahⁿ-KOR see-NYAY nuh vahⁿ-dohⁿ pa la POH duh LOORS

items.fr: Samedi, il faisait un temps de chien et j'avais le cafard.
items.en: On Saturday the weather was foul and I felt low.
